row_order: observation order, then unchanged Candidates.edges/fractions/distances order; IDs persisted separately, never numerical features

features.name: distance_m
features.description: Exact observation-to-directed-segment distance in projected metres

features.name: log1p_distance_m
features.description: log(1 + lateral distance in metres)

features.name: distance_squared_10m
features.description: Squared lateral distance divided by 100, clipped at 10000

features.name: distance_minus_nearest_m
features.description: Lateral distance minus nearest candidate distance

features.name: distance_ratio_nearest
features.description: (distance+1)/(nearest distance+1), clipped at 100

features.name: strict_distance_rank
features.description: Fraction of other candidates strictly closer (ties share a rank)

features.name: candidate_count
features.description: Number of candidates at this observation

features.name: nearest_distinct_gap_m
features.description: Distance gap between nearest and next distinct lateral distance

features.name: fraction
features.description: Clipped projection fraction along the directed arc

features.name: distance_to_endpoint_m
features.description: Along-segment distance to the nearer endpoint

features.name: log1p_edge_length_m
features.description: log(1 + segment length in metres)

features.name: projection_is_interior
features.description: Projection is strictly inside the segment

features.name: heading_cos_short
features.description: Signed arc alignment with centred +/-1 observation GPS motion

features.name: heading_cos_medium
features.description: Signed arc alignment with centred +/-3 observation GPS motion

features.name: heading_cos_long
features.description: Signed arc alignment with centred +/-8 observation GPS motion

features.name: heading_abs_cos_medium
features.description: Undirected medium-window alignment

features.name: heading_reliability_short
features.description: Short-window displacement / 12m clipped to [0,1]

features.name: heading_reliability_medium
features.description: Medium-window displacement / 12m clipped to [0,1]

features.name: heading_reliability_long
features.description: Long-window displacement / 12m clipped to [0,1]

features.name: reliable_direction_mismatch
features.description: (1 - signed medium alignment) times heading reliability

features.name: previous_lateral_distance_m
features.description: Distance from GPS observation three rows earlier to this segment

features.name: next_lateral_distance_m
features.description: Distance from GPS observation three rows later to this segment

features.name: neighbour_mean_lateral_distance_m
features.description: Mean of previous and next lateral distances

features.name: neighbour_max_lateral_distance_m
features.description: Maximum of previous and next lateral distances

features.name: neighbour_projected_speed_mps
features.description: Signed speed of neighbouring GPS projections along this segment

features.name: motion_along_arc_mps
features.description: Medium GPS velocity dotted with unit directed arc vector; duration floored at 1s

features.name: log1p_speed_short_mps
features.description: log(1 + short centred GPS speed); duration floored at 1s

features.name: log1p_speed_medium_mps
features.description: log(1 + medium centred GPS speed); duration floored at 1s

features.name: speed_change_mps
features.description: Forward minus backward local GPS speed, clipped to +/-100m/s

features.name: gps_turn_cos
features.description: Cosine between incoming and outgoing +/-3 GPS motion vectors

features.name: log1p_previous_gap_s
features.description: log(1 + time since previous GPS observation)

features.name: log1p_next_gap_s
features.description: log(1 + time to next GPS observation)

features.name: low_motion
features.description: Medium-window GPS displacement below 3 metres

features.name: log1p_tail_indegree
features.description: Canonical directed incoming degree of arc tail

features.name: log1p_tail_outdegree
features.description: Canonical directed outgoing degree of arc tail

features.name: log1p_head_indegree
features.description: Canonical directed incoming degree of arc head

features.name: log1p_head_outdegree
features.description: Canonical directed outgoing degree of arc head

features.name: edge_is_zero_length
features.description: Segment length below one micrometre
